SELECT allocation_id AS allocationId,source_id AS sourceId,source_line_id AS sourceLineId, lot_id AS lotId,sku_id AS skuId,quantity,allocation_type AS allocationType, policy_version_id AS policyVersionId,expiry_date AS expiryDate FROM inv_lot_allocation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND source_event_id=#{eventId} ORDER BY allocation_id

SELECT s.allocation_id AS allocationId,s.source_id AS sourceId,s.source_line_id AS sourceLineId, s.lot_id AS lotId,s.sku_id AS skuId, (s.quantity-COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity),0)) AS quantity,s.allocation_type AS allocationType, s.policy_version_id AS policyVersionId,s.expiry_date AS expiryDate FROM inv_lot_allocation s LEFT JOIN inv_lot_allocation r ON r.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND r.allocation_type='RETURN' AND r.original_source_id=s.source_id AND r.original_source_line_id=s.source_line_id AND r.lot_id=s.lot_id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.allocation_type='SALE' AND s.source_id=#{originalSourceId} AND s.source_line_id=#{originalSourceLineId} AND s.sku_id=#{skuId} GROUP BY s.allocation_id,s.source_id,s.source_line_id,s.lot_id,s.sku_id,s.quantity, s.allocation_type,s.policy_version_id,s.expiry_date HAVING quantity>0 ORDER BY s.allocation_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.allocation_id AS allocationId,s.source_id AS sourceId,s.source_line_id AS sourceLineId, s.lot_id AS lotId,s.sku_id AS skuId, (s.quantity-COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity),0)) AS quantity,s.allocation_type AS allocationType, s.policy_version_id AS policyVersionId,s.expiry_date AS expiryDate FROM inv_lot_allocation s LEFT JOIN inv_lot_allocation r ON r.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND r.allocation_type='EXPLICIT' AND r.original_source_id=s.source_id AND r.original_source_line_id=s.allocation_id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.allocation_type='EXPLICIT' AND s.source_id=#{dispatchId} AND s.source_line_id=#{dispatchLineId} AND s.lot_id=#{sourceLotId} AND s.sku_id=#{skuId} GROUP BY s.allocation_id,s.source_id,s.source_line_id,s.lot_id,s.sku_id,s.quantity, s.allocation_type,s.policy_version_id,s.expiry_date HAVING quantity>0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inv_lot_expiry_projection(tenant_id,lot_id,expiry_status,as_of_business_date, near_expiry_days,on_hand_quantity,last_ledger_sequence,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{lotId},#{expiryStatus},#{asOfBusinessDate},#{nearExpiryDays},#{onHandQuantity}, #{lastLedgerSequence},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE expiry_status=VALUES(expiry_status),as_of_business_date=VALUES(as_of_business_date), near_expiry_days=VALUES(near_expiry_days),on_hand_quantity=VALUES(on_hand_quantity), last_ledger_sequence=VALUES(last_ledger_sequence),updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM inv_lot_identity i JOIN inv_lot_balance b ON b.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND b.lot_id=i.lot_id LEFT JOIN inv_lot_expiry_projection p ON p.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND p.lot_id=i.lot_id WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND i.store_id=#{storeId} AND i.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND b.on_hand_quantity>0 ORDER BY i.expiry_date,i.lot_id LIMIT 500
